description: Land Title Settlement Department - Maha Kowama, Mallawapitiya, D/S/Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420207 (24/0499)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, cadastral map references, locations, and owner details) by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership registration, property boundaries, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
